# Three.js 0.185.1 (MIT)

Unmodified runtime files copied from the project's locked `three@0.185.1` npm dependency.
Includes the ES module/core, OrbitControls, RoomEnvironment, RoundedBoxGeometry,
RectAreaLightUniformsLib and its RectAreaLightTexturesLib dependency.

CardScope uses this same-origin subset so photo previews do not depend on a third-party JavaScript CDN.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r185
License: see LICENSE in this directory.
